source.name: Calcio Napoli 24 - Maglia Napoli 2026/2027, i ricavi dagli sponsor sono da record
source.quote: DongFeng (sponsor di manica): 4 milioni di euro

note: Sleeve partner since 2025-26 as Global Automotive Partner; originally announced in January 2026 as running to the end of the 2027/28 season (club announcement, 23 January 2026). The club's own 6 July 2026 kit-unveil page and Calcio e Finanza (7 July 2026) both say the deal now runs until 2029, so the end date is set to the 2028/29 season. Value per Calcio Napoli 24 citing the 2026-27 shirt-revenue breakdown.
